motion.name: hover lift
motion.effect: The face rises 1 px and the base grows 1 px, so the base's bottom edge stays put.
motion.godot_plan: Button 'hover' StyleBox with the base 1 px taller and the face 1 px higher (comment in motion-preview.css)

motion.name: press sink
motion.css: secondary: translateY(5px), base 1 px; primary: translateY(6px), base 1 px
motion.effect: The face travels its full rest base (5 or 6 px) and keeps a 1 px base, so the base's bottom edge ends 1 px lower than at rest. Travel = rest base - 1 (4 or 5 px) would keep that edge fixed; which one is intended is open.
motion.godot_plan: Button 'pressed' StyleBox: shadow offset 1 px, content moved down by the same amount (comment in motion-preview.css)

motion.name: card press
motion.applies_to: .card (all variants, including the quiet .card.dimtext with no base)
motion.css: translateY(3px); the 5 px base is not changed
motion.effect: The whole card and its base move down 3 px; it shifts rather than sinks onto its base, unlike the buttons. No hover state for cards.

motion.name: timing
motion.godot_plan: a short Tween, about 70 ms (comment); Tween has TRANS_*/EASE_* pairs only, no cubic-bezier (lens 3), so the token needs a Godot pair in $extensions

motion.name: reduced motion
motion.effect: The hover and press offsets still apply, instantly. No other Toy rule animates.
motion.godot_plan: DisplayServer.accessibility_should_reduce_animation() exists in the 4.7.2 API dump; lens 6 proposes zero-duration tokens or Tween.set_speed_scale

motion.name: not covered
motion.effect: No hover or press feedback anywhere else; cursor: pointer only on .btn:not(.ghost) and .card.

motion.name: static rotation
motion.effect: A facing angle in the frame, a runtime value in the game (Control.rotation), not a token. No tilted plates remain (the engineer rejected tilts on 2026-10-03), though the toy.css header still lists 'rotation of whole elements' and meta.json pitch_en still mentions tilted title plates.

motion.name: missing motion
motion.effect: Not specified anywhere yet: spinner rotation (.ring), the ~3 s intro/outro fades (pre game, post game), panel open and close (Esc, map on M), tab switch, bar fill and health colour changes, hold-to-give-up progress (F), countdowns, the 3 s protection chip.
